# Recorded examples

The examples on this page run in CI against these recordings from the live bridge, replayed by a stand-in bridge that answers only a call the recording fits:

- [`stats_meta_metafor.json`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLibRust/blob/main/tests/fixtures/stats_meta_metafor.json)

# Same verb in other bindings

| Python (pyMzLib) | Rust (mzLibRust) | R (mzLibR) |
|---|---|---|
| `pymzlib.stats.meta` | `mzlib::stats::meta_with` with `MetaOptions` | `stats_meta` |

# References

- [doi:10.1016/0197-2456(86)90046-2](https://doi.org/10.1016/0197-2456(86)90046-2): the moment estimator of the between-study variance (DerSimonian and Laird, Control Clin Trials 7:177, 1986)
- [doi:10.18637/jss.v036.i03](https://doi.org/10.18637/jss.v036.i03): metafor, whose rma(method = 'DL') mzLib reproduces to 1e-8 relative (Viechtbauer, J Stat Softw 36(3), 2010)

# Not yet verified

The spec lists these as open; they are reported, never hidden:

- Rust and R spellings are proposals until those bindings ship the verb.
- The example's studies are mzLib's metafor reference cases (Test/StatisticalModels/ReferenceData/dl\_inputs.tsv), copied verbatim to pkg/python/tests/fixtures/stats/metafor\_dl\_inputs.tsv. They are constructed cases, not proteomics data.
